item.title: Chery Tiggo range builds strong UK appeal
item.description: LONDON: Chery UK registered 2,127 cars in January 2026, Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders (SMMT) figures show. With sales starting in September 2025, this takes Chery’s first five months of trading in the UK to 7,644 cars, securing a 1.48% market share in January.
